formal_role: Defines modeled variables dimension units and system state representation
systems_modeling_role: Determines what simulation can track over time
review_warning: Excluded variables and poor scaling can distort simulated behavior

formal_role: Defines how system moves from one state to next
systems_modeling_role: Encodes modeled dynamics interactions feedback and external inputs
review_warning: Transition assumptions should be validated against mechanisms and evidence

formal_role: Defines parameter values ranges and scenario assumptions
systems_modeling_role: Controls how alternative futures or system conditions are explored
review_warning: Weak parameter ranges can create misleading scenario confidence

formal_role: Defines random inputs shock distributions covariance and sampling process
systems_modeling_role: Determines how uncertainty propagates through simulation
review_warning: Distribution and covariance assumptions should be documented and tested

formal_role: Defines number of runs random seeds scenarios and summary statistics
systems_modeling_role: Supports uncertainty ranges risk estimates and robustness review
review_warning: A single trajectory should not be overinterpreted as a forecast

formal_role: Defines sparsity projection low-rank approximation or reduced-order modeling
systems_modeling_role: Controls computation and interpretability in large state spaces
review_warning: Compression may remove weak signals rare events or local structure

formal_role: Defines calibration holdout tests numerical checks and comparison with observed behavior
systems_modeling_role: Evaluates whether simulation outputs are credible for intended use
review_warning: Validation is partial evidence not proof of future accuracy

formal_role: Defines how assumptions uncertainty sensitivity limitations and decision consequences are communicated
systems_modeling_role: Prevents simulated outcomes from being overstated as predictions or certainty
review_warning: Simulation should support structured reasoning not replace judgment
